title: Generating Functions Lab
summary: Generating functions as a calculus for discrete structures: pick a problem, see its objects, encode them as coefficients, manipulate the series, read a coefficient back and watch an independent enumeration agree. Thirty-four levels run from the geometric series, shifts and Fibonacci through convolution, coin change, compositions, Catalan, Lagrange inversion, EGFs and the exponential formula, partitions and singularity analysis, to roots-of-unity filters, the DFT as evaluation at roots of unity, the inverse DFT as coefficient extraction and the cyclic convolution theorem. Explore, Guided, Problems (a 22-step ladder with hints), Compare and Transform modes, a Fourier lab with the exact N = 4 example and the character table, a finite-vector sandbox, exact integer, rational and cyclotomic arithmetic, a command palette, deep links, an in-page presentation and beamdswitch Markdown export. Runs offline.
